{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/penguins.csv')

# Compute mean of flipper_length_mm and body_mass_g for imputation
mean_flipper = df['flipper_length_mm'].mean()
mean_mass = df['body_mass_g'].mean()

# Impute missing values
# Note: Only 2 rows have missing values in both columns; we'll impute both
# We use the global mean for simplicity, assuming missingness is random
imputed_df = df.copy()
imputed_df['flipper_length_mm'] = imputed_df['flipper_length_mm'].fillna(mean_flipper)
imputed_df['body_mass_g'] = imputed_df['body_mass_g'].fillna(mean_mass)

# Compute Pearson correlation on the full 344 rows
corr = imputed_df['flipper_length_mm'].corr(imputed_df['body_mass_g'])

# Print the result
print(corr)"}
